questions.question: [Coordinate Geometry] Find the equation of the circle with diameter endpoints A(1,2) and B(5,6). Find the tangent at A.
questions.correctAnswer: Centre = midpoint of AB = (3,4). Radius = half of AB = ½sqrt((5-1)^2+(6-2)^2) = ½sqrt32 = 2sqrt2. Circle: (x-3)^2+(y-4)^2=8. Gradient of radius OA = (2-4)/(1-3)=1. Tangent gradient = -1. Tangent at A: y-2 = -1(x-1) -> y = -x+3
questions.explanation: Centre = midpoint of AB = (3,4). Radius = half of AB = ½sqrt((5-1)^2+(6-2)^2) = ½sqrt32 = 2sqrt2. Circle: (x-3)^2+(y-4)^2=8. Gradient of radius OA = (2-4)/(1-3)=1. Tangent gradient = -1. Tangent at A: y-2 = -1(x-1) -> y = -x+3

questions.question: [Differentiation] Find the stationary points of y = x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x + 5 and determine their nature
[Integration] Evaluate ∫₀^2 xsqrt(4 - x^2) dx using substitution u = 4 - x^2
questions.correctAnswer: u = 4 - x^2, du = -2x dx -> x dx = -½ du. Limits: x=0->u=4, x=2->u=0. ∫₄⁰ sqrtu (-½)du = ½∫₀⁴ u^½ du = ½[⅔u^⅔]₀⁴ = ⅓(8) = 8/3

questions.question: [Quadratic Equations] Solve 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0 and hence solve 2sin^2θ - 5sinθ - 3 = 0 for 0 <= θ < 2pi
[Trigonometry] Solve 2 sin 2θ = sqrt3 cos θ for 0 <= θ < 2pi
questions.correctAnswer: 2(2 sin θ cos θ) = sqrt3 cos θ -> cos θ(4 sin θ - sqrt3) = 0. cos θ = 0 -> θ = pi/2, 3pi/2. sin θ = sqrt3/4 ≈ 0.433 -> θ ≈ 0.448, 2.694
